comment: Trap questions a caller plausibly asks but the corpus cannot answer. NEVER embedded into the index — used only for threshold tuning and the no-fabrication evals. The bot must deflect on every one of these.

entries.question: Where is my order right now?
paraphrases: mera order abhi kahan hai
मेरा ऑर्डर अभी कहाँ है

entries.question: When exactly will my package be delivered tomorrow?
paraphrases: kal mera package kitne baje aayega
कल मेरा पैकेज कितने बजे आएगा

entries.question: What is the price of the iPhone 16 on Amazon?
paraphrases: iphone 16 ka price kya hai amazon pe
आईफोन सोलह का प्राइस क्या है

entries.question: Is the Samsung 55 inch TV in stock right now?
paraphrases: samsung tv stock mein hai kya abhi
सैमसंग टीवी स्टॉक में है क्या

entries.question: How do I become a seller on Amazon?
paraphrases: amazon pe seller kaise bante hain
अमेज़न पर सेलर कैसे बनते हैं

entries.question: Which movies are coming to Prime Video this month?
paraphrases: prime video pe is mahine kaunsi movie aa rahi hai
प्राइम वीडियो पर कौन सी मूवी आ रही है

entries.question: Can I get no cost EMI on my HDFC card for this phone?
paraphrases: hdfc card pe no cost emi milegi kya
एचडीएफसी कार्ड पर नो कॉस्ट ईएमआई मिलेगी क्या

entries.question: Is Flipkart cheaper than Amazon for electronics?
paraphrases: flipkart sasta hai ya amazon
फ्लिपकार्ट सस्ता है या अमेज़न

entries.question: What is my current Amazon Pay balance?
paraphrases: mera amazon pay balance kitna hai
मेरा अमेज़न पे बैलेंस कितना है

entries.question: Cancel my Prime membership and give me a refund for it.
paraphrases: meri prime membership cancel karke refund do
मेरी प्राइम मेंबरशिप कैंसिल करके रिफंड दो
